request.query: Multiply a strict real power bound by a positive power and add the exponents

items.name: ENNReal.rpow_add
items.type: ∀ {x : ENNReal} (y z : ℝ), x ≠ 0 → x ≠ ⊤ → x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z

items.name: ENNReal.zpow_add
items.type: ∀ {x : ENNReal}, x ≠ 0 → x ≠ ⊤ → ∀ (m n : ℤ), x ^ (m + n) = x ^ m * x ^ n

items.name: ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg
items.type: ∀ {x : ENNReal} (y z : ℝ), 0 ≤ y → 0 ≤ z → x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z

items.name: Real.rpow_add'
items.type: ∀ {x y z : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → y + z ≠ 0 → x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
